learning_outcomes.text: Familiarization of students with various methods of polymer processing.
Addressing simple problems of polymer processing with synthesis of knowledge from polymers and transport phenomena
Understanding the importance of polymers in the production of several everyday life products.
Development of analytical, interdisciplinary and critical thinking
Develop methodology for the simplification and solution of difficult problems with practical significance
Production of free, creative and inductive thinking

syllabus_topics: Molecular origin of viscosity, entropic origin of elasticity.
Flow of polymer melts in conduits.
Examples of polymer processing operations (extrudate swell and melt fracture, extrusion of thermoplastics, calendaring, blow molding).

Special topics (main forces – excluded volume, van der Waals, electrostatic, hydrodynamic, hydrogen bonding, applications in rheology of polymer melts and solutions, hard and soft spheres, concentration dispersions and microstructure, thixotropy, sedimentation, rheometry, extensional rheology).

assessment_methods.method: Participation in class and response to questions

assessment_rules: Students are evaluated with homework problems, a project, mandatory participation in class and response to questions, and a final exam in Greek involving problem solutions. Oral examination is offered to students with learning disabilities. Students have the right to see their exam after grades are announced and ask questions. The course evaluation is discussed during the first class and posted on the web.
